summary: Iteration 20 — Prep Time Estimation & Order Throttling. Backend: 18/18 new pytest tests pass covering POST /api/store/eta (categories + item_ids + empty), GET/PATCH /admin/throttle/settings (auth + validation on max_concurrent_orders/slot_granularity/base_buffer/auto_pause), GET /admin/throttle/status shape, at_capacity transition (cap<active → asap_available=false, next_available_slot in future), GET/PUT /admin/prep-times DRY-verified against kds_settings collection, maybe_auto_pause() direct invocation flips store pause_ordering and /store/eta reflects paused:true, order creation derives estimated_minutes from ETA (not hardcoded), regression smoke on /admin/queue/live /admin/printers /search/menu /admin/analytics/summary. Frontend: /admin/throttle page fully functional (all 10 required testids present, 10 prep-rows render, badge shows 'Normal', load shows '2/15 active 13%', base_buffer edit persists across reload); /admin/queue throttle-banner renders with data-state='normal' and text 'Normal — accepting ASAP orders 2 / 15 · 13%'; 'Prep & Throttle' sidebar link routes to /admin/throttle; /checkout summary-eta displays 'Ready in ~20 min' wired to /api/store/eta.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED BY TESTER: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLiveQueue.js had 40 lines of orphan JSX garbage after the proper closing brace (line 374+ starting with 'y-6 border border-dashed...') causing a SyntaxError: Missing semicolon (374:3) that prevented the entire frontend from compiling. Deleted lines 374-414; file now ends cleanly at line 373 with '}'.

FIXED BY TESTER: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLiveQueue.js referenced `throttle` and `setThrottle` (lines 89, 205, 208-223) but never declared `const [throttle, setThrottle] = useState(null);`. Caused PAGEERROR 'throttle is not defined' on /admin/queue which suppressed throttle-banner rendering. Added the useState hook after sortBy.
Good: /store/eta public endpoint correctly resolves categories from item_ids by reading menu_items.category; accepts empty body (default 10 min eta).
Good: capacity_state computation is clean — ratio>=1 → at_capacity, 0.7-1 → busy, else normal; paused short-circuits to 'paused'.
Good: next_available_slot correctly computes rounded-up granularity with spacing buffer, returns ISO8601 UTC.
Good: maybe_auto_pause is idempotent via Mongo filter {pause_ordering:{$ne:true}} — will only flip if currently false. Per spec, does NOT auto-unpause (explicit admin action required).
Good: PUT /admin/prep-times proxies to kds_settings collection for DRY (verified via direct Mongo read — test asserts kds_settings.target_prep_minutes_by_category.test_cat_zzz == 17 after PUT).
Good: order creation pipeline uses _compute_eta_payload for estimated_minutes. Verified order doc has estimated_minutes within ±10 of /store/eta for same category.
Nit: throttle.py line 88 defaults cap to 15 when stored value is 0/None — acceptable but worth documenting.
Nit: _next_slot_iso uses target.minute % granularity; if granularity=60 and minute=0 but second/microsecond > 0, still advances — correct behavior.

Nit: Auto-pause is only triggered from payments.py payment-status transition; if orders change state through admin/advance without re-entering paid state, threshold won't be re-evaluated. Acceptable per spec.
